title: skip exact small-dyadic rounding
change_description: A pure integer guard returns an already representable small dyadic rational unchanged; every rejected input uses the previous software rounding algorithm. Unconditional refinement retains the frozen binary64 model for all rational inputs. No Float callback or trusted primitive changes. [Implementation and proof evidence](../docs/GEN26-ROUND-IDENTITY.md).
row_note: Proved exact small-dyadic rounding identity; full fixed/fresh 10M validation; clean fresh build; CPU 0; 3+21 ABAB
review_threshold: Both decode and CPR must independently reach 2/1; exact integer comparisons of measured medians; stop for user review only when both hold.
note: Prepared after completed fixed/fresh/native validation and before timing. Contains no speculative measurement. The unchanged reviewed reporting helper archives only completed measurements.
